answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 15 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 685 identities costs 685 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the wharf here is verification, the horizon of cost is what stops the farm, and the island of the record keeps every claim checkable.
